description: Temporary, bounded exceptions to the perpetual alphabetical rotation for specific calendar weeks (local America/New_York Sundays). Each entry pins one week's featured country to a specific manifest key, regardless of what the alphabetical schedule would otherwise show that week. The country that would have naturally aired that week is not lost or reordered anywhere else — it simply airs on its own next natural occurrence, one full rotation cycle later. martinique and mayotte are not sovereign countries and are intentionally absent from country-index.json; their posts are imported separately from data/one-off-features.json and only ever appear via the two entries below. See docs/decisions/0006-temporary-schedule-overrides.md. This file is for bounded, near-term editorial exceptions only — it must never be used to permanently reorder the rotation; that requires a new manifest_version and migration ADR per country-index.json's own change policy.
